description: TabCmdr is a Raycast-like command palette for your browser that helps you instantly search tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads, and recently closed tabs. It includes AI chat, calculator, RSS, weather, screenshots, emoji picker, password/UUID generators, tab management, 32 themes, powerful keyboard shortcuts, and integrations for GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Jira, Figma, YouTube, Discord, and more all without leaving your current tab.
